scenes.caption: A gloomy wood.
scenes.say: Zara writes about a creature in a gloomy wood.

scenes.caption: A dull line.
scenes.say: She writes: the creature went into the wood.

scenes.caption: A stronger verb.
scenes.say: She changes went to crept. Now it sounds sneaky.

scenes.caption: A precise adjective.
scenes.say: She adds gloomy and tangled to describe the wood.

scenes.caption: A made-up word.
scenes.say: She invents the word gloomble for the creature.

scenes.caption: A pronoun.
scenes.say: She uses it instead of repeating the creature.

scenes.caption: A peer edit.
scenes.say: A partner finds one strong word and one weak word.

scenes.caption: A sharper opening.
scenes.say: Zara's opening now paints a clear, gloomy picture.
